prompt: a coffee cup Chris Cooley drew frame by frame in 2015 (kept by the Wayback Machine, 23 April 2015), rebuilt as an arcade toy in Fizlet from the same sprite sheet: tap and the pour streams in and splashes, steam curls off the full cup; tap again and it slurps and wobbles; mid-pour it turns back from the frame it is on
title: The coffee cup pours, splashes, steams and slurps (2015, arcade)
author: chris-cooley
